from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class QuarterlyFinance(BaseModel):
    """One quarter of financial data from a single document."""
    year: int | None = Field(description="The year of the quarter")
    quarter: int | None = Field(description="The quarter number (1-4)")
    growth_rate: float | None = Field(description="Year-over-year net profit growth rate percentage")
    net_profit: float | None = Field(description="Net profit attributable to shareholders")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. 'yuan'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief excerpt from document with the data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    quarterly_finance_data: list[QuarterlyFinance]
